decision.article_title: L’agentic AI stationne au Mondial de l'Auto, mais sa gouvernance n'est pas à bord - ZDNET
decision.reason: ZDNet read article citing Capgemini survey: 68% of automotive executives testing/using agentic AI in product R&D but only 5% full governance. A purely manual AI R&D agent accountability, data and human-approval ledger is hypothesized; must compare historic governance offerings at validation.

opportunities.idea_name: Automotive Agentic R&D Governance Evidence Desk
opportunities.core_job: Track governance owner, data provenance, decision outputs and engineering human signoff for AI agents used during automotive R&D
opportunities.target_customer: Automotive OEM and Tier-1 product development AI governance teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: AI use case+owner register → training/test dataset provenance references → allowed design/R&D decisions → human override/evidence → risk ownership/review
opportunities.why_now: Capgemini survey covered by ZDNet 13 October 2026 reports 68% surveyed auto firms already using or trialing agentic R&D but only 5% claim full governance, exposing traceability and accountability gaps
opportunities.before_state: Vehicle R&D uses agents while accountability, tests and policy reviews split across spreadsheets
opportunities.after_state: Human-reviewed versioned R&D use-case record and scoped governance readiness checklist
